title: Billing-Class Scale on Add-On Down Payments
content:
**Patient Payment Plans — billing-class scale on add-on down payments**

The add-on down payment is scaled by the billing class of the invoice being added: by one half for an Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice or a Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice, by three quarters for an Out-of-Network Balance Invoice, and not at all for any other class.

| Billing class of the invoice being added (as shown in Patient Invoices & Statements) | Class scale |
|---|---|
| Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | One half (a multiplier of 0.5) |
| Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | One half (a multiplier of 0.5) |
| Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | Three quarters (a multiplier of 0.75) |
| Self-Pay Patient Invoice, or any other class | Not scaled (a multiplier of 1) |

The class is the billing class of the one invoice being added, read from its invoice record; the classes of the invoices already on the plan play no part.

## Where the class scale enters

The class scale is a multiplier inside the product that forms the add-on down payment: the balance due on the invoice being added is multiplied, all together, by the plan's down-payment percentage, by any raise or other scale that applies, and by the class scale; that single product is rounded to the nearest cent, an exact half cent being rounded up, and only then is it compared with the add-on minimum. The class scale is never applied to an amount already rounded, nor to the add-on minimum.

## Hypothetical illustrations (down-payment percentage 10; no raise and no other scale)

| Invoice being added | Balance due | Product | Add-on down payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | 600.00 | 600.00 by 10 percent by 0.5 is 30.00 | 30.00 |
| Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | 600.00 | 600.00 by 10 percent by 0.75 is 45.00 | 45.00 |
| Self-Pay Patient Invoice | 600.00 | 600.00 by 10 percent is 60.00 | 60.00 |
| Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice, add-on minimum 25.00 | 180.00 | 180.00 by 10 percent by 0.5 is 9.00 | 25.00 — the scaled product is below the minimum, and the minimum itself is not scaled |
